title: A New Bike
author: Tadoku Note (original)
summary: 10歳の誕生日に自転車をもらったミア。何度転んでも、また乗ってみます。

source.note: Original text written for this app.

paragraphs: Mia is ten years old. She lives in a small town. Her house is near a park.
Today is her birthday. Her father gives her a big box. “Open it,” he says.
Mia opens the box. It is a bike! It is red and new. Mia is very happy.
“Can I ride it now?” she asks. “Yes,” says her father. “But be careful.”
Mia goes to the park. She gets on the bike. She falls down. She gets up. She tries again.
She falls down again. Her knee hurts a little. But she does not cry.
Her father holds the bike. “Look up,” he says. “Do not look at your feet.”
Mia looks up. She rides slowly. Her father lets go. Mia does not know it. She rides and rides.
“Dad, look!” she says. But her father is far away. He is smiling.
“You did it!” he says. Mia stops the bike. She laughs. “I can ride! I can really ride!”
That night, Mia puts the bike next to her bed. She looks at it for a long time. Then she sleeps with a smile.
